summary: Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of 7 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles and 136 drones against Ukraine, with air defenses intercepting 5 missiles and 104 drones but confirming hits from 2 ballistic missiles and 27 strike drones across 18 locations. Simultaneously, Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Filanovsky oil platform, two sanctioned vessels, and a Molniya-class missile boat in the Caspian Sea, prompting Iran to accuse Ukraine of killing one sailor and wounding another. Russian forces also claimed strikes on a Kyiv drone-production facility and fuel storage in Chornomorsk port.
key_points: Russia fired 7 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles and 136 Shahed/Gerbera/Italmas drones overnight; Ukrainian air defense shot down 5 missiles and 104 drones, with 2 missiles and 27 drones hitting 18 locations. (Source: @UkraineNow/82935)
Ukrainian SBU drones hit the Filanovsky oil platform, sanctioned vessels Port Olya 2 and Begey, and a Project 12418 Molniya missile boat in the Caspian Sea. (Source: @UkraineNow/82923)

Iran formally accused Ukraine of attacking its merchant ship in the Caspian Sea, killing one sailor and wounding another, and threatened retaliation under international law. (Source: @UkraineNow/82934)

Russian MoD claimed a group strike with high-precision weapons on Ukrainian defense-industry enterprises, specifically naming the "Smart Intelligent Systems" plant in Kyiv producing UAVs and fuel tanks in Chornomorsk port. (Source: @tass_agency/387143)

Romanian and Italian NATO fighters (F-16 and Eurofighter Typhoon) shot down a drone violating Romanian airspace ~300 km from the Ukrainian border, the second such incident in two days. (Source: @UkraineNow/82920)

Zelensky stated Russia is preparing to receive 30,000 additional North Korean troops in Voronezh region since June and that Pyongyang is readying new ballistic missile launchers for transfer to Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/82928)

TASS calculations show Ukraine's power generation at 11-12 GW versus 18-19 GW needed for winter, with only 6 GW restoration planned by year-end — insufficient before October. (Source: @tass_agency/387135)

Russian forces claimed liberation of Zakharovka and Ivashkino villages in Kharkiv sector by 126th Motorized Rifle Regiment and 34th Guards Brigade/11th Tank Battalion respectively. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)

points: Ukrainian SBU long-range drones conducted a coordinated strike in the Caspian Sea, hitting the Filanovsky oil platform, the sanctioned vessels Port Olya 2 and Begey (both used for Iran-Russia military cargo), and a Project 12418 Molniya-class missile boat. (Source: @UkraineNow/82923)

Ukrainian air defense intercepted 5 of 7 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles and 104 of 136 Shahed/Gerbera/Italmas drones overnight, but acknowledged 2 ballistic missiles and 27 strike drones hit 18 locations with debris falling on 7 more. (Source: @UkraineNow/82935)
A Shahed drone was tracked near Slavutych heading toward Vyshhorod/Kyiv region, indicating continued pressure on the capital's approaches. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69396)
Ukrainian forces reportedly conducted counterattacks near Stepnohorsk on the Zaporizhzhia front while Enerhodar suffered another massive attack. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)

Ukraine's energy system operates at 11-12 GW against a winter requirement of 18-19 GW; only 6 GW of restoration is planned by year-end, leaving a critical deficit before October. (Source: @tass_agency/387135)

Russian forces launched a combined strike of 1 Kh-59/69 cruise missile, 7 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles, and 136 drones overnight 25-26 July, targeting locations across northern, southern, and eastern Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/82935)

Russian MoD claimed a group strike with high-precision ground- and air-launched weapons on Ukrainian defense-industry enterprises, specifically the "Smart Intelligent Systems" plant in Kyiv producing UAVs and fuel reservoirs in Chornomorsk port. (Source: @tass_agency/387143)
Russian air defense destroyed 16 Ukrainian UAVs over Kaluga region with no reported casualties. (Source: @tass_agency/387136)
Russian tactical aviation showed increased activity in the northeastern sector, posing a threat of air strikes on frontline areas in Chernihiv and Sumy regions. (Source: @kpszsu/70112)

Russia is preparing to receive 30,000 additional North Korean troops in Voronezh region since June, and Pyongyang is readying new ballistic missile launchers for transfer to Moscow. (Source: @UkraineNow/82928)

Russian forces claimed liberation of Zakharovka (Volchansky district) by the 126th Motorized Rifle Regiment of the 71st Guards Motorized Rifle Division and Ivashkino by the 34th Guards Mountain Motorized Rifle Brigade and 11th Tank Battalion of the 18th Motorized Rifle Division. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)
In the Kupyansk sector, fighting continues in the western part of the town south of the Oskol River. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)
On the Konstantinivka front, active fighting persists near Nikolaypole village while Konstantinivka town is still being cleared of enemy forces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)

Units of the "East" group of forces captured strongholds west of Aleksandrovka and advanced toward Zelenoye in Dnipropetrovsk region, with Far Eastern formations breaking through Ukrainian defenses in eastern Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)
KAB guided bombs were employed against targets in Kharkiv and Donetsk regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/102716)
Reactive UAVs were directed toward Kryvyi Rih city. (Source: @kpszsu/70132)
Ballistic missiles transited Chernihiv region toward Kyiv, with a group of UAVs moving southward through northern Chernihivshchyna. (Source: @kpszsu/70108, @kpszsu/70128)
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region was reported. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69391)

In Sumy region, 2 UAVs were detected near Krolevets (from north) and 1 near Esman; infantry battles continue in Ulanovo, Malaya Slobodka, Ryzhovka, Pisarevka, Mogritsa, Maryino, Novaya Sech, Khoten, and border village Prokhody. (Source: @eRadarrua/102716, @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)
Russian forces claimed 16 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed over Kaluga region. (Source: @tass_agency/387136)

Belgorod region suffered multiple drone attacks: commercial building hit in Belgorod city, apartment building in Dubovoye, rocket fire on Kazachya Lisitsa (2 dead, 1 injured), apartment building in Shebekino, Ozon delivery truck hit, tractor driver injured in Veselaya Lopana; 40 residents affected and 1 dead on July 23 alone. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)
Ukrainian drones struck the Filanovsky oil platform, Port Olya 2, Begey, and a Molniya-class missile boat in the Caspian Sea. (Source: @UkraineNow/82923)
Russian strikes targeted fuel reservoirs in Chornomorsk port intended for Ukrainian forces. (Source: @tass_agency/387143)
Continued strikes reported against ports in Odesa and Mykolaiv regions and Ukrainian merchant fleet in the Black Sea. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)
Enerhodar (Zaporizhzhia NPP vicinity) subjected to another massive attack. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)
Kherson region: 3 civilians killed and 12 injured in past 24 hours; explosions and shelling recorded in Aleshki and Radensk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)
Reactive UAVs directed toward Zaporizhzhia city. (Source: @kpszsu/70087)

Overnight 25-26 July: Russia launched 1 Kh-59/69, 7 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles, 136 Shahed/Gerbera/Italmas drones; Ukraine intercepted 1 Kh-59/69, 5 Iskander-M/S-400, 104 drones; 2 ballistic missiles and 27 strike drones hit 18 locations, debris on 7 locations. (Source: @UkraineNow/82935)

Kyiv experienced air raid alerts at 02:49 and 03:20 on 26 July (cleared at 01:12 and 03:20), with ballistic missiles transiting Chernihiv region toward the capital. (Source: @eRadarrua/102713, @eRadarrua/102717, @kpszsu/70108)

Romanian F-16s and Italian Eurofighter Typhoons (NATO air policing) shot down a drone violating Romanian airspace ~300 km from Ukraine border — second such intercept in two days. (Source: @UkraineNow/82920)
Russian air defense destroyed 16 Ukrainian UAVs over Kaluga region. (Source: @tass_agency/387136)
Russian tactical aviation active in northeastern direction, threatening frontline areas with air strikes. (Source: @kpszsu/70112)
KAB guided bombs used on Kharkiv and Donetsk regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/102716)

Mass drone flights reported over Bryansk and Belgorod regions toward central Russia; >250 drones toward Moscow region on July 24, 16 shot down on approach, 210 total daytime intercepts claimed by Russian MoD. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31909)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation across multiple domains — massive Russian missile/drone barrage, Ukrainian deep strikes into the Caspian Sea, NATO air policing intercepts, and North Korean force generation — indicates a broadening conflict geometry. Russia's ability to sustain 136-drone/7-missile salvos suggests robust production or stockpiles, while Ukraine's penetration of Caspian defenses demonstrates growing long-range strike capacity. Iran's direct accusation and threat of retaliation introduces a new state actor into the maritime dimension. The North Korean troop deployment (30,000 additional) and missile launcher transfers signal a deepening Moscow-Pyongyang military alliance that extends the threat envelope to Northeast Asia. Ukraine's energy deficit (7-8 GW shortfall by winter) remains a critical strategic vulnerability that Russia will likely exploit with continued infrastructure strikes.
sections.regional_response: Romania's second NATO-coordinated intercept in two days (F-16s and Italian Eurofighters) demonstrates Alliance readiness to defend airspace against spillover, but the 300 km distance from Ukraine highlights the growing reach of Russian drone operations. Iran's invocation of "lawful self-defense" and explicit threat to hold Ukraine, its "supporters and instigators" responsible marks a significant rhetorical escalation that could precipitate direct Iranian involvement or proxy actions. Kazakhstan's president telling Putin the conflict's "essence and origin" are unclear to many reflects growing Central Asian discomfort with Russia's war trajectory. The North Korean troop rotation through Voronezh and missile launcher transfers indicate Russia is institutionalizing DPRK military integration, which will alarm South Korea, Japan, and the US.
sections.intelligence_notes: The organizer of the military exhibition near Kyiv hit by Iskander missiles has been detained, suggesting Ukrainian counterintelligence is investigating potential security breaches that enabled the strike on a gathering of ~300 military, industry, and foreign personnel with a shelter only 100 meters away. The illegal detention of a disabled, tuberculosis-afflicted man in a Zakarpattia TCR/SP underscores systemic mobilization abuses that Lubinets says are "only the tip of the iceberg." Russian claims of striking "Smart Intelligent Systems" in Kyiv (UAV production) and Chornomorsk fuel storage align with a sustained campaign to degrade Ukraine's drone manufacturing and logistics. The TASS-cited energy deficit (11-12 GW vs 18-19 GW needed) with only 6 GW restoration planned by year-end confirms a looming humanitarian and industrial crisis that will constrain Ukrainian defense production and civilian resilience this winter.
